title: Company Objective Compass: initiative acceptance criteria, escalation gates, and traceability ledger
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Purpose: create a compact, actionable artifact (the 'Objective Compass') that maps company-level OKRs to explicit initiative acceptance criteria, escalation gates, and a traceability ledger so teams can sign up to commitments with clarity on trade-offs and when to escalate. Scope: 1) define a minimal schema that PMs/Leads use to bind OKRs -> initiative outcomes, success metrics, acceptance criteria, and fallbacks; 2) document escalation gates (who, when, and what evidence) and decision thresholds for deprioritization or scope reduction; 3) produce a searchable ledger (Confluence + CSV export) that preserves lineage (objective -> initiative -> owner -> artifact links) for audit and postmortem; 4) pilot with 4 cross-functional initiatives in Q1 and iterate. Out of scope: automated enforcement in the Console (follow-up project).

acceptance_criteria: Each pilot initiative has a documented acceptance criteria entry that maps to at least one company OKR with measurable KPI and owner.
Escalation gates defined for 'red' and 'amber' states with named decision owners and maximum time-to-decision.
Traceability ledger populated for 4 pilot initiatives with links to PRDs, design files, engineering epics, and exec snapshots.
CSV export of the ledger generated and validated against schema (columns: objective_id, initiative_key, owner, metrics, acceptance, escalation_gate, evidence_links).
Pilot retrospective with cross-functional stakeholders completed and a prioritized backlog of improvements created.
decision_thresholds: Amber: initiative misses weekly health metric by 10% for two consecutive sprints -> notify PM lead and schedule 48-hour decision window.
Red: initiative misses monthly KPI target by >20% or critical dependency fails -> trigger exec escalation and assess rollback/cut scope within 72 hours.
Funding threshold: >15% additional funding request requires Finance + GTM approval before continuation.
stakeholders: Aisha Malik - Head of Product Strategy (owner)
metrics: Objective OKR-1: Improve inference unit economics - initiative KPI: cost per 1k tokens reduced by 12% (baseline Feb 2025)
Objective OKR-2: Increase platform reliability - initiative KPI: P95 latency under target for 95% of traffic
Traceability metric: 100% of pilot initiatives have at least one artifact link to PRD + design + engineering epic
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: socialize schema and onboarding guide to PMs and ENG leads; Week 3: populate pilot ledger entries; Week 4-6: monitor pilot initiatives and exercise escalation gates; Week 7: pilot retro and adoption decision (scale vs iterate). Deliverables: schema v1.0, Confluence template, CSV export, one-page exec decision snapshot template.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Excessive overhead causes teams to avoid adoption. Mitigation: keep schema intentionally minimal and provide a one-click CSV import/export.
Risk: Missing telemetry makes decision thresholds meaningless. Mitigation: ENG-20421 to deliver minimum telemetry contract; delay pilot until confirmed.
Risk: Conflicting escalation ownership across functions. Mitigation: publish a RACI matrix with named alternates and tie escalation to explicit meeting cadences.
